content.text:
If you’re in the **U.S.**, the safest place to get working Domino’s voucher/coupon codes is the **official Domino’s coupons page** — deals vary by local store and delivery/carryout. ([dominos.com](https://www.dominos.com/pages/order/coupon?lang=en&utm_source=openai))

**Current notable deal:** Domino’s is running **50% off menu-priced pizzas from June 1–7, 2026** — today, **June 7, 2026**, appears to be the last day. ([ir.dominos.com](https://ir.dominos.com/node/24631/pdf?utm_source=openai))

Other common Domino’s deals you may see in the app/site include:

- **Mix & Match Deal** — usually a set price when you buy 2+ qualifying items. ([dominos.com](https://www.dominos.com/?type=order_carryout&utm_source=openai))  
- **Local carryout/delivery coupons** — enter your address or choose your store to see them. ([dominos.com](https://www.dominos.com/pages/order/coupon?lang=en&utm_source=openai))  
- **Rewards/free pizza offers** if you sign in to Domino’s Rewards. ([dominos.com](https://www.dominos.com/?clienttype=generic&utm_source=openai))  

Tip: third-party coupon sites list codes, but Domino’s official coupons/app are usually more reliable, since franchise participation varies by location.
